rule_or_step_title: Exclusionary Findings: Phenotypes Absent in CdLS6
matching_criterion_description: Severe transverse limb defects have a 0% penetrance across all published BRD4 cohorts; presence in a patient actively argues against CdLS6.

rule_or_step_title: Exclusionary Findings: Phenotypes Absent in CdLS6
matching_criterion_description: Oligodactyly is absent in confirmed BRD4 cohorts; limb anomalies in CdLS6 are strictly restricted to minor terminal findings.
Presence of synophrys along with arched eyebrows, thin upper lip, and mild-to-moderate ID in the absence of limb reductions prioritizes BRD4 sequencing.
